entry.title: Post a ball, then find it
entry.summary: The authors describe a posting box whose ball is found by opening a drawer, using one hand to open and the other to retrieve. The ball and every part need to be suitable for mouthing.
entry.cue: Your baby is releasing objects deliberately and looking for where they have gone.
detail: Unlike a box with an open tray, the drawer keeps the ball out of view until the baby opens it. The baby can repeat the part that interests them.
The appendix also describes a knitted-ball version with an opening slightly smaller than its soft ball. This adds pushing the ball through before retrieving it.
